title: Diamonds on the Night Express
call: Inspector {name}, a merchant's diamonds were stolen on the Hyderabad–Chennai Express.
The train hasn't stopped since. The thief is still on board.
arrival: Passengers are peeking out of their curtains. The merchant is crying.

briefing.label: Stolen
briefing.value: A bag of diamonds, worth ₹5 crore

examination.title: Examine the merchant's bag

spots.title: Side
spots.text: A long, neat cut along the side.

examination.question: How did the thief open the bag?
examination.why: The zip is closed, but there's a neat cut. The thief used a blade.

interview.alibi: I was fast asleep on my upper berth. I never woke up!
replies: A knife? I'm a bride, I don't even cook.
gotchas: This gold glitter is from YOUR wedding saree, Meera!
Bangles don't rattle like stones, Meera!

interview.alibi: I was asleep after my show. Dancers sleep like the dead!
replies: Yes, I'm a passenger. So are 70 other people in this coach!
My costume is in a sealed bag. Look, not one sparkle is missing.
My bag has only my costumes. Open it, I don't mind!
interview.release: Ruby's costume bag was sealed by the theatre company. Not one sparkle was missing.

interview.alibi: I was watching movies on my phone till 4 AM. With headphones!
replies: I'm a passenger, sir, but I only carry a pencil, not a knife.
Glitter? I've worn this same T-shirt for three days, sir.
Check my phone. I never stopped watching.
interview.release: Kabir's phone shows he watched movies non-stop from 1 to 4 AM.

leads.from: 👜 A long, neat cut in the bag
leads.question: The cut is long and very neat, made in one go. What made it?
leads.reveal: A small sharp knife! You check the dustbin by the door…
leads.name: Small knife
leads.found: A small knife, wrapped in a **PASSENGER ticket** for coach S4. Something gold sparkles on the handle.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who is NOT a passenger.
leads.why: Railway staff don't carry passenger tickets.
leads.card: A knife wrapped in a PASSENGER ticket

leads.from: 🔪 Gold sparkles on the knife handle
leads.question: Tiny gold sparkles stuck on the handle. Where do they come from?
wrongWhy: Ice would have melted by now.
leads.reveal: Glitter! You follow the sparkles to the berth ladder…
leads.name: Glitter trail
leads.found: Gold **glitter** on every step of the ladder, going **up**.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who wears glittery clothes.
leads.why: Meera, Ruby and Aunty Sarla all wear glittery clothes.

leads.from: ✨ The glitter goes UP the ladder
leads.question: The glitter trail goes up the ladder and stops. Where did the thief hide the diamonds?
wrongWhy: The trail goes up, not down.
The door is locked. The train is moving fast.
leads.reveal: An upper berth! You climb up and check the bags…
leads.name: Rattling bangle box
leads.found: A **bangle box** that rattles like stones, hidden on an **upper berth**.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who is NOT on an upper berth.
leads.why: Uncle Gupta and Aunty Sarla sleep on lower berths.
leads.card: A rattling BANGLE BOX on an upper berth

confession: "There was no wedding. My 'husband' is my partner. We do this on every train."
escapeStory: Meera jumped off at the next station. She was caught selling a diamond the next day.
